stations.title: Elspeth
stations.say: Can the kiosk ring my bell?
stations.note: She answers the door all day.

stations.title: Welcome kiosk
stations.text: Buttons and a question that look right.

captions: At the front door, Elspeth wants the kiosk to ring her bell when a visitor needs help.
The kiosk has buttons, but pressing them does nothing at the desk.
You give each button and the question a function to run, in four tasks.
A press on Ring for help rings the bell at the desk, once per press.
Same kiosk, now it answers. Tickets print and the tally counts every answer.
